paragraphs: International Business Machines Corporation (IBM) is an American multinational technology company headquartered in Armonk, New York, and present in over 175 countries. It is a publicly traded company and one of the 30 companies in the Dow Jones Industrial Average. IBM is the largest industrial research organization in the world, with 19 research facilities across a dozen countries; for 29 consecutive years, from 1993 to 2021, it held the record for most annual U.S. patents generated by a business.

IBM was founded in 1911 as the Computing-Tabulating-Recording Company (CTR), a holding company of manufacturers of record-keeping and measuring systems. It was renamed "International Business Machines" in 1924 and soon became the leading manufacturer of punch-card tabulating systems. During the 1960s and 1970s, the IBM mainframe, exemplified by the System/360 and its successors, was the world's dominant computing platform, with the company producing 80 percent of computers in the U.S. and 70 percent of computers worldwide. Embracing both business and scientific computing, System/360 was the first family of computers designed to cover a complete range of applications from small to large.

IBM entered the microcomputer market in 1981 with the IBM Personal Computer; its architecture remains the basis for the majority of personal computers sold today. The company later also found success in the laptop space with the ThinkPad. Since the 1990s, IBM has concentrated on computer services, software, supercomputers, and scientific research; it sold its microcomputer division to Lenovo in 2005. IBM continues to develop mainframes, and its supercomputers have consistently ranked among the most powerful in the world in the 21st century.

As one of the world's oldest and largest technology companies, IBM has been responsible for several technological innovations, including the Automated Teller Machine (ATM), Dynamic Random-Access Memory (DRAM), the floppy disk, Generalized Markup Language, the hard disk drive, the magnetic stripe card, the relational database, the SQL programming language, and the Universal Product Code (UPC) barcode. The company has made inroads in advanced computer chips, quantum computing, artificial intelligence, and data infrastructure. IBM employees and alumni have won various recognitions for their scientific research and inventions, including six Nobel Prizes and six Turing Awards.

people.name: Arvind Krishna
people.title: Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer
people.bio: Krishna is IBM's Chairman, President and Chief Executive Officer and a member of its Board of Directors. The executive officers table lists him as an officer since 2020.
people.quote: Arvind Krishna, Chairman of the Board, President and Chief Executive Officer (1)

people.name: Gary D. Cohn
people.title: Vice Chairman
people.bio: Cohn serves as IBM's Vice Chairman. The executive officers table lists him as an officer since 2021.
people.quote: Gary D. Cohn, Vice Chairman | 65 | | 2021

people.name: Nicolas A. Fehring
people.title: Vice President and Controller
people.bio: Fehring serves as IBM's Vice President and Controller. The executive officers table lists him as an officer since 2023.
people.quote: Nicolas A. Fehring, Vice President and Controller | 47 | | 2023

people.name: James J. Kavanaugh
people.title: Senior Vice President, Finance and Operations, and Chief Financial Officer
people.bio: Kavanaugh serves as IBM's Senior Vice President, Finance and Operations, and Chief Financial Officer. The executive officers table lists him as an officer since 2008.
people.quote: James J. Kavanaugh, Senior Vice President, Finance and Operations, and Chief Financial Officer

people.name: Nickle J. LaMoreaux
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer
people.bio: LaMoreaux serves as IBM's Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer. The executive officers table lists her as an officer since 2020.
people.quote: Nickle J. LaMoreaux, Senior Vice President and Chief Human Resources Officer

people.name: Anne Robinson
people.title: Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer
people.bio: Robinson serves as IBM's Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer and is listed as an officer since 2024. She previously served as Managing Director, General Counsel and Corporate Secretary of The Vanguard Group, Inc. and Secretary of the Vanguard funds from August 2016 until June 2024.
people.quote: Anne Robinson, Senior Vice President and Chief Legal Officer

people.name: Robert D. Thomas
people.title: Senior Vice President, Software and Chief Commercial Officer
people.bio: Thomas serves as IBM's Senior Vice President, Software and Chief Commercial Officer. The executive officers table lists him as an officer since 2023.
people.quote: Robert D. Thomas, Senior Vice President, Software and Chief Commercial Officer

people.name: David N. Farr
people.title: Retired Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Emerson Electric Co.
people.bio: Joined Emerson in 1981 and held various executive positions, including chairman and chief executive officer, until his retirement in 2021.
people.quote: Mr. Farr, 71, joined Emerson in 1981 and subsequently held various executive positions.

people.name: Alex Gorsky
people.title: Former Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, Johnson & Johnson
people.bio: Joined Johnson & Johnson in 1988 and became chief executive officer and chairman in 2012. Transitioned to executive chairman at the end of 2021.
people.quote: Mr. Gorsky, 65, is the former chairman and chief executive officer of Johnson & Johnson

people.name: Michelle J. Howard
people.title: Retired Admiral, United States Navy
people.bio: Served in the U.S. Navy from 1982 until retiring in 2017. In 2014, became the Navy's first woman four-star admiral and the first woman and African American appointed Vice Chief of Naval Operations.
people.quote: Admiral Michelle J. Howard, 65, is a retired U.S. Navy officer.

people.name: Arvind Krishna
people.title: Chair of the Board
people.bio: Joined IBM in 1990 and became chief executive officer and a director in April 2020; was elected board chairman in December 2020. Previously led IBM's Cloud and Cognitive Software business and Research division.
people.quote: Arvind Krishna, 63, became the chief executive officer of IBM, and a member of the Board of Directors, in April 2020.

people.name: Ramon Laguarta
people.title: Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, PepsiCo, Inc.
people.bio: Joined PepsiCo in 1996 and held numerous leadership roles across Europe and global markets. Became chief executive officer in 2018 and chairman in 2019.
people.quote: Mr. Laguarta, 62, serves as chairman and chief executive officer at PepsiCo.

people.name: Andrew N. Liveris
people.title: Retired Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, The Dow Chemical Company
people.bio: Joined Dow in 1976, becoming president and chief executive officer in 2004 and chairman in 2006. Transitioned to executive chairman of DowDuPont in late 2017 and retired in July 2018.
people.quote: Mr. Liveris, 71, joined Dow in 1976 and subsequently held various executive positions

people.name: Frederick William McNabb III
people.title: Retired Chairman and Chief Executive Officer, The Vanguard Group, Inc.
people.bio: Served as Vanguard's chairman from 2008 until retiring in 2018 and as chief executive officer from 2008 to 2017. Is a director of UnitedHealth Group and Axiom.
people.quote: Mr. McNabb, 68, served as chairman of The Vanguard Group, Inc. from 2008 until his retirement in 2018

people.name: Michael Miebach
people.title: Chief Executive Officer, Mastercard Incorporated
people.bio: Is chief executive officer of Mastercard Incorporated and has been an IBM director since 2023.
people.quote: Messrs. Buberl, Miebach, Waddell and Dr. Pollack each served as members of the Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee in 2025.

people.name: Alfred W. Zollar
people.title: Former Executive Advisor, Siris Capital Group, LLC
people.bio: Retired from IBM in 2011 following a 34-year career in its systems and software groups. Subsequently served as an executive partner and executive advisor at Siris Capital Group.
people.quote: Mr. Zollar retired from IBM in 2011 following a 34-year career

people.name: Marianne C. Brown
people.title: Director, IBM
people.bio: Serves on IBM's Directors and Corporate Governance Committee and was determined by the Board to meet its independence standards.
people.quote: M.C. Brown, T. Buberl, D.N. Farr, A. Gorsky, M.J. Howard, R. Laguarta, A.N. Liveris

people.title: Director, IBM
committees: Executive Compensation and Management Resources (Chair effective April 28, 2026)
people.bio: Served on IBM's Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee in 2025. Will become its chair and join the Executive Committee effective April 28, 2026.

people.name: Martha E. Pollack
people.title: Director, IBM
people.bio: Served on IBM's Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee in 2025. The text identifies all members of that committee as independent directors who were not employees or former employees of IBM.
people.quote: Messrs. Buberl, Miebach, Waddell and Dr. Pollack each served as members of the Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee in 2025.

people.name: Peter R. Voser
people.title: Director, IBM
people.bio: Chairs IBM's Audit Committee and serves on its Executive Committee. Is identified as an Audit Committee Financial Expert.
people.quote: M. Miebach, F.W. McNabb III, M.E. Pollack, P.R. Voser, F.H. Waddell, and A.W. Zollar.

people.name: Frederick H. Waddell
people.title: Director, IBM
committees: Executive Compensation and Management Resources (Chair until April 28, 2026)
people.bio: Chairs IBM's Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee, with Thomas Buberl to succeed him effective April 28, 2026. Serves on the Executive Committee until April 28, 2026.
people.quote: Messrs. Buberl, Miebach, Waddell and Dr. Pollack each served as members of the Executive Compensation and Management Resources Committee in 2025.
